integrity_notes: The proven theorem includes complete finite-absorption classification, stopping-time laws, a divergent-second-moment example, and an open nonresonant asymptotic separation.
The standalone exact-rational checker supplies finite arithmetic consistency checks, not an infinite-time or independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact real arithmetic and two independent uniformly sampled orthogonal rows are assumed; the theorem does not cover nonorthogonal systems or nonlinear sparse shrinkage.
The integer-relaxation resonance is not stable under perturbation, although the separate almost-sure/mean-square convergence gap is open in the relaxation parameter.
The second-moment identity is already accessible through published general averaged-Kaczmarz bounds and is not asserted novel by itself.
title: Finite-time absorption and mean-square explosion in averaged randomized Kaczmarz
